# Derrick — Construction Company Template

Recreation of ColorLib "Vertex" — a construction company landing page with hero slider, stats counter, services grid, portfolio gallery, testimonials carousel, pricing cards, and blog section.

## Design Notes

- **Font:** Quicksand (300, 400, 500, 700) via Google Fonts
- **Primary:** #0962ea (blue) — buttons, links, slider overlay, footer
- **Light bg:** #f8f9fa — counter, portfolio, pricing sections
- **Buttons:** square corners (no border-radius)
- **Slider:** full-viewport height, blue overlay at 0.8 opacity
- **Footer:** blue background matching primary color
- **Pricing:** dashed borders, building skyline icon, $29/mo all plans
